verdict.rationale: A government business-formalities portal could plausibly publish official SDKs, so the axis applies. The INPI evidence describes only the web portal (filing, payment, signatures, dashboards) and a guidance app, with no official SDK. The keyless JSON probe is of a separate state company-data API, not an INPI Guichet unique SDK, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
